problems.text: radxa and orange_pi_4a list only the router in /etc/resolv.conf, so a query the router drops fails the lookup outright.

goals.text: A single dropped DNS answer from the router costs about a second, not a failed request, for host-network jobs on those nodes.

outcomes.change: The network playbook gives radxa and orange_pi_4a three resolvers with a short timeout
outcomes.checked_by: `ansible-playbook --syntax-check`, a test that reads the play's hosts and file content, then /etc/resolv.conf on both nodes after the operator runs it

outcomes.change: The knowledge bundle records the resolver set-up and why
